headline: Cinematography agency to be liquidated, cinemas to connect to a unified ticketing system, 37 organizations to finance films
summary: Uzbekistan is liquidating the Cinematography Agency and 19 system organisations to form the O'zbekfilm national film company. Cinemas will be required to join a unified ticketing system.
why: State film financing and cinema ticketing shape the size and structure of Uzbekistan's domestic entertainment market.
original_headline: Kinematografiya agentligi tugatiladi, kinoteatrlar yagona chipta tizimiga ulanadi, 37 ta tashkilot film moliyalashtiradi
